findings: updateNeedsToBeSent now has 22 writes, and they sit exactly where a network dirty bit belongs: TradingPost -[contentsDidChange], TradingPost/Sign/Stairs -[paint:], Door -[checkAndUpdateBlockedStatus], FreeBlock -[initWithWorld:dynamicWorld:saveDict:cache:]
isNet still has 0 writes through this channel, so its writer uses another mechanism (a constructor field store, memset, or a form still unclassified)
World.fastForward keeps exactly 1 site and it is still a READ, so the world-clock claim survives the better classifier - the same correction that flips the flag census leaves that one intact
boundary: access labels remain a heuristic over the instruction window; the fused rule is checked before the add form because a fused site has no add to find
method attribution is unreliable in runs of adjacent getters (0x83d1xx): cell identity is reliable, the method name is not
